## What is Conversational AI?

Revolutionizing human technology interaction

For decades, customer communication meant the same thing. IVR menus, scripted chatbots, and long hold times. Conversational AI bots replace all of it with agents that actually listen, understand, and act in real time, across voice and chat.

Watch intro

### Before Conversational AI

"Press 1 for billing, press 2 for ...". Rigid IVR phone trees that frustrate customers before they reach a human.

Rule-based chatbots that follow scripts. One unexpected question and the whole experience falls apart.

Customers repeat themselves every time they switch channels, phone to chat to email. Nothing carries over.

Scaling means hiring. More agents, more shifts, more training, more cost. Quality varies person to person and call to call.

Single-language support, or clunky handoffs between language-specific teams that slow resolution and lose key context.

### With our Conversational AI platform

Customers speak naturally and get understood. No menus, no keywords, no waiting.

Grounded in your knowledge base, agents adapt to questions, edge cases, and topic changes in real time.

Seamless continuity across voice, chat, phone, and web. One conversation, one context, regardless of channel.

Scales instantly to handle millions conversations at a fraction of the cost. No hiring surges, no training ramps, no inconsistency.

Real-time language detection and switching across 90+ languages. Agents serve global customers without transfers or delays.

## Build your first conversational AI in 5 minutes

[Watch tutorial](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fnivYSh0Cqk&list=PL0p_X3zznhlNfieOUQnxLMrrRersZBqB-)

Define your procedures

Monitor and Improve

Track conversations, identify gaps, and refine performance over time from an intuitive dashboard.
